decisions.reason: As a recent launch close to the firm's hearing-related core business, Product A is likely to be retained because some commitment has already been made and there is no clear evidence yet that weak results cannot be temporary.

Product B was given its own page and explicit launch messaging, so the firm's public commitment and fit with its established offer make management likely to continue it rather than admit an early mistake.

Product C is close to the firm's established dental-production equipment business and likely involved meaningful development and commercialization effort, which under escalation of commitment supports keeping it on the market absent clear failure.
